subject: Nick Giurleo City Council Candidacy
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Medford City Council candidate Nick Giurleo about his background, motivations for running, and policy positions. Giurleo discussed major issues facing the city, including affordability, government transparency, and Medford Square development.

items.title: Introduction of Nick Giurleo
items.summary: Host John Petrella welcomed Medford City Council candidate Nick Giurleo to the program.

items.title: Candidate Background
items.summary: Giurleo detailed his personal, educational, and professional background as a lifelong Medford resident and practicing attorney.

items.title: Motivation for Candidacy
items.summary: Giurleo explained that his love for Medford and dissatisfaction with current city leadership motivated him to run for office.

items.title: Key Issues Facing Medford
items.summary: Giurleo identified affordability, economic growth, and government transparency as the three major issues currently facing the city.

items.title: Positions on Ballot Questions and Overrides
items.summary: Giurleo explained his opposition to the recent tax override and debt exclusion ballot questions, advocating instead for the utilization of free cash and commercial growth.

items.title: Medford Square Development and Revitalization
items.summary: Giurleo discussed the proposed development in Medford Square, emphasizing the need for revitalization while addressing parking, traffic, senior center impacts, and community input.

items.title: Public Participation and Transparency
items.summary: Giurleo criticized recent restrictions on public comment time and late-night council procedures, proposing reforms to make local government more accessible.

items.title: Campaign Outreach and Community Involvement
items.summary: Giurleo shared how residents can contact his campaign and highlighted his favorite local spots, including the Medford Public Library and the Middlesex Fells.

items.title: Program Outro
items.summary: Petrella concluded the interview by thanking the guest and providing contact information for viewer feedback and suggestions.
